en: The postcard is sepia-toned and features a landscape view with trees, open fields, and a faint outline of mountains or hills in the distance. The front side has a handwritten German caption at the bottom, while the back side includes printed and stamped German text indicating it is for the 'Kur- und Erholungshaus St.Georgs-Villa / Bad Pyrmont' on Bombergallee 8, with a museum stamp from Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.
